{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to inspect revenue more carefully
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for thousands separators in revenue
# Look for commas, which would indicate thousands separators
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any()

# Check for malformed values or non-numeric strings
# Extract non-numeric revenue values
non_numeric = df[~df['revenue'].str.replace('.', '', regex=False).str.isnumeric()]

print(f'Has thousands separators (commas)? {has_commas}')
print(f'Non-numeric revenue values: {non_numeric["revenue"].unique().tolist()}')"}
